title: Automatic occurrence-order elimination and sparse SAT witnesses
claims: LocalityEliminationWidth and FirstOccurrenceEliminationWidth give checked sufficient conditions for bounded intermediate signed clause cardinality.
MeasuredOccurrenceElimination obtains a complete variable order from the canonical formula word and checks all intermediate widths.
ExactOccurrenceEliminationSAT proves exact P membership for the canonical SAT language guarded by bounded occurrence-order elimination width.
FirstOccurrenceLocalityWitness recovers a verified sparse model from the formula alone under a fixed first-occurrence locality bound.

experiments.purpose: Bind all archived Lean overlay sources and the recorded exact statements to the local reference replay. The isolated experiment reports its live Lean invocation count, which may be zero.
